card.text: M3 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 10,180 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 3 is a globular cluster located 33.9 thousand light years from Earth in the northern constellation of Canes Venatici.

introduction.text: M3 is drawn as 3,365 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
